subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled Cloudflare AI Gateway onboarding flow add a Workers AI endpoint/model selector now, or should OpenClaw document the generic custom-provider Workers AI setup and leave the bundled auth choice Anthropic-only until the broader Cloudflare bridge is designed?
rationale: The requested fix changes provider defaults, CLI/setup surface, model catalog shape, and possibly auth/header behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent Cloudflare product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add provider-owned Workers AI mode
options.body: Implement a Cloudflare plugin/onboarding mode that writes the Workers AI endpoint, OpenAI-compatible API family, `@cf/...` model rows, docs, and tests while preserving existing Anthropic setup.

options.title: Fold into the broader bridge issue
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation until the broader Cloudflare AI Gateway bridge and REST contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554 is decided.

options.title: Document custom-provider only
options.body: Close only after documenting an exact supported `custom-api-key` Workers AI onboarding command and explaining that the bundled Cloudflare auth choice remains Anthropic-specific.

recommendation.title: Add provider-owned Workers AI mode
recommendation.body: Implement a Cloudflare plugin/onboarding mode that writes the Workers AI endpoint, OpenAI-compatible API family, `@cf/...` model rows, docs, and tests while preserving existing Anthropic setup.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review by steipete already framed the product choice and the decision spans provider UX rather than a purely mechanical code repair.
